lockFileMaintenance.description: Renovate cannot read the locked version of a workspace dependency that npm hoists to the root (renovatebot/renovate discussion #47546), so it never proposes in-range updates for most of core's dependencies. Refreshing the whole lockfile weekly brings those updates, including security fixes, in anyway; see #567 and #568.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Never raise a range that core or testing publishes: a zod range above the copy chanfana gets installs a second zod that chanfana never extends (#510). A security fix that needs a new range is made by hand as fix(deps).

packageRules.description: npm updates only change the lockfile, which isn't published, so they don't trigger a release
Majors change the ranges core and testing publish, so they are only raised when approved on the Dependency Dashboard (#510)
